title: Gas report - Week 45
summary:
LNG
The LNG market strengthened this week, with relatively high fixing activity east of Suez helping to tighten vessel availability. The Atlantic also saw a gradual improvement in spot rates, although cargo demand remains relatively subdued and the tonnage list continues to limit further upside. On the BLNG1 Australia-Japan route, rates increased by $9,600 week-on-week to settle at $54,600/day.

children.title: LPG
children.summary: The LPG market firmed this week, with a healthy level of fixture activity in the West supporting rates. With further cargoes still being worked and vessel availability broadly balanced against demand, sentiment remains positive.
